Help the game to ship in an excellent technical state

• Strong leadership skills working as a CTO, Technical Director or Lead managing teams of 10 or more with an ability to enable others to solve technical problems

• Clear, open and collaborative communication style and an ability to interact effortlessly with diverse groups internally and stakeholders externally.

• Ability to operate at different levels of technical understanding in a way that is inclusive of different opinions

• Open minded about how to solve problems and excited by technical developments in the game industry

• Understanding of Unreal Engine or in-house engines where source code is available

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager within Process Automation at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Does the idea of being part of the largest pharmaceutical projects in Denmark and managing complex Process Automation projects excite you? And do you thrive on defining and executing project strategies in close corporation with highly skilled colleagues? Then you’ll fit right in!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

As a Senior Project Manager within Process Automation, you will be part of our large project portfolio in Kalundborg. You will play an important role in ensuring the successful execution of our deliveries and will be in close contact with both internal and external stakeholders.

As part of your role, you will maintain close dialogue with your team on-site and participate in regular meetings across disciplines, ensuring transparency, efficiency, and execution according to our plans.

The technical focus of this position is Process Automation, working with DCS 800xA and ECS solutions interfacing with new technologies within the Industry 4.0 domain and Manufacturing IT solutions. Our projects cover the entire project lifecycle, from conceptual and basic design phases to on-site testing activities, including FAT, Interface Testing, Wet Testing, SAT, and UAT, culminating in handover to our customers.

Based on your skills and experience, several opportunities are available within our portfolio.

How you might spend your days

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

• 
Executing projects within your area in close collaboration with your team, identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures.

• 
Focusing on overall project planning, ensuring delivery quality, and planning the necessary resources to maintain schedule and cost targets.

• 
Estimating costs and planning budgets in collaboration with our engineers and specialists.

• 
Managing project scope and ensuring that changes are analysed and agreed upon with stakeholders.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• 
Work across the boundaries and you like to work in a diverse and international environment

• 
Create results through efficient project management and communication, leveraging from your relations to your team and stakeholder

• 
Have a personal commitment, known for your effectiveness and an open management style and know the impotency to win as a team

• 
Are fluent in English both written and spoken

What you bring to the role

To be successful in this role, we expect you to have the following experience and educational background:

• 
An educational background at bachelor's level or a similar relevant technical background.

• 
6–10 years of experience with a proven track record in DCS and ECS/PLC Process Automation projects, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.

• 
Experience with GMP project execution and preferable knowledge with S88 and S95

• 
Experience in executing Process Automation projects in collaboration with other disciplines, such as mechanical and process design, as well as end users.

• 
Experience with on-site commissioning activities, including FAT, SAT, and UAT.

• 
Project Management certification, e.g. PMP or PRINCE2, is preferred.

If you do not meet all the requirements, you are still welcome to apply and provide alternative experience that you believe would be valuable in this role.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, it means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 15th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Søren Frisenborg Marker on +45 3191 8696

Please note:

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 3,000 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About the team

Deloitte’s ServiceNow department is looking for an experienced Enterprise Service Management Advisor and Solution Architect to join our A-team of ServiceNow advisors. As a Manager in our ServiceNow department, you will serve as a trusted advisor for our clients, guiding them on their digitalization journey. In this role, you will work with industry leading professionals, guiding clients through end-to-end digital transformation initiatives and driving complex enterprise-wide service modernization.

As a trusted advisor, you will play a key role in identifying and pursuing strategic business opportunities while leading the design and implementation of innovative ServiceNow solutions. You will collaborate with clients to transform IT, HR, Finance, Risk, and core business functions into streamlined, service-based organizations. This involves assessing the client’s needs, translating business requirements into tailored technology solutions, and providing strategic and best practice advisory. You will oversee the full project lifecycle, ensuring seamless execution from strategy to deployment, while providing thought leadership and industry insights that shape best practices.

Success in this role requires a deep understanding of enterprise service management, strong leadership in project execution, and the ability to build long-term client relationships based on trust and value creation. By delivering impactful solutions and driving meaningful business outcomes, you will help position Deloitte as the premier partner for digital transformation.

Job Description

ServiceNow is its own department, and you will join a team of incredibly dedicated, ambitious and great colleagues. Our team works closely together on projects across the Nordics, combining the right expertise and competencies to deliver the best solutions for our clients. While we thrive on cross-border collaboration, you will also have a strong local presence in our Copenhagen office, where we emphasize teamwork, community, and a shared commitment to excellence.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Providing strategic advisory for some of the largest ServiceNow clients in Denmark and the Nordics.

• Engaging proactively with clients, advising on solution and problem scoping across the organization to ensure alignment with business objectives.

• Designing comprehensive solutions, including technical design using design thinking methodologies to ensure alignment with ServiceNow’s Enterprise Service Management capabilities and best practices.

• Helping our clients in defining and optimizing Service Management processes to drive efficiency.

• Offering insights and guidance on application development, agile development, software development lifecycle and cloud applications.

• Leading the delivery of solutions and support teams in corrective measures.

• Work closely with Program Leadership to oversee and lead multiple workstreams of technical design- and delivery activities, create and maintain a network of potential clients, and be known as a trusted advisor and participate in consulting sales activities, including writing service proposals.

Qualifications

By joining our team as a Manager, you will become part of and contribute to our shared success. You will build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients to exceed expectations. Key responsibilities and tasks will involve:

You have the following skills and experience:

• A minimum of 5 years of experience working with ServiceNow or other digitalization platforms.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Hands-on experience leading end-to-end transformation projects in areas such as IT, HR, Finance, Risk or core business operations.

• Experience with IT Project Management and have the ability to oversee complex implementations and drive successful outcomes.

• Demonstrated consulting experience or prior experience as a Platform Owner, showcasing your ability to advise and lead clients through transformation initiatives.

• Familiarity with process frameworks such as Lean, TBM, ITIL or other methodologies relevant to your area of expertise.

• A strong technical background with an advanced understanding of key technical principles and best practices.

• Experience or a solid understanding of application development and software lifecycle management.

• Knowledge of technologies using client-server model and understanding of data-modelling, SQL data structures and system integrations.

• You are fluent in written and spoken English, and you should ideally have a high proficiency in Danish or a willingness to learn the language.

• You must have the right to live and work in Denmark.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success**.**

What we offer you:

At Deloitte, we provide an environment where you can grow, innovate, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the ServiceNow field. Joining our team means becoming part of a dynamic and supportive workplace that values both professional and personal development.

• You will work alongside experts in the ServiceNow field, gaining insights and knowledge from top professionals in the field.

• You will experience a culture of continuous growth, where feedback and learning opportunities empower you to advance at your own pace.

• You will enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, allowing you to balance work and personal commitments in a way that suits you the best.

• You will gain access to ServiceNow certifications in the areas that interest you, enhancing your expertise and career prospects.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV and cover letter. In your cover letter, please describe your motivation and answer these following questions:

• ServiceNow Experience: Can you detail your hands-on experience with ServiceNow, including specific modules and functionalities you have worked with? Please provide examples of complex implementations or customizations you have led.

• Project Management Experience: Describe your project management experience, if possible in the context of ServiceNow projects. How have you managed multiple stakeholders and ensured project success?

We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: As soon as possible.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Are you an experienced project professional who excels at building structure, driving consistency, and elevating project execution?

To support our growth and expanding portfolio of projects, we are strengthening our focus on the Project Management Office (PMO). You’ll get a key role in developing, maintain, train, and educate on the processes, methodology, and tool chain used in project execution.

Your Role

As PMO Lead, you will report to the Head of Projects & Delivery. You will become responsible for all aspects of our best-practice project execution and will be deeply involved in improving and developing our methodologies.

The PMO standardizes project practices, supports project managers and project teams, and represents a highly operational function.

The PMO ensures alignment with business goals by supporting Business Management and provides oversight across the project portfolio. The PMO spans governance, methodology, reporting, process development, and process control. The PMO leads the development of methodologies used during the scale-up of the organization – and may potentially evolve into the competence center for Project Management.

Your tasks include:

• Governance & Standards: Define, maintain, and continuously improve PM methodologies, templates, and best practices, ensuring compliance with processes, quality standards, and stage-gate governance.

• Project Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor project performance across scope, schedule, budget, and risks, and consolidate insights into portfolio dashboards and KPIs for leadership decision-making.

• Resource & Capacity Support: Support resource allocation and forecasting with Team Leads and Project Managers, identify bottlenecks, and help optimize utilization across the project portfolio.

• Support & Enablement: Enable Project Managers through coaching, training, and hands-on support with documentation, planning, tools, and evaluation of new project opportunities.

• Risk, Issue & Change Management: Support structured identification and handling of risks, issues, and changes, including escalation processes and decision forums.

• PMO Development: Drive continuous improvement of PMO methodologies and capabilities to support faster, more scalable, and predictable project delivery aligned with business growth.

The PMO Lead role is highly central to harmonizing and further professionalizing our project execution capability. Running activities according to standards, ensuring quality in execution, and ensuring predictability and repeatability will be key elements of our success. This work will happen in close collaboration with the Engineering Excellence Manager. Furthermore, the PMO Lead will act as the deputy to the Head of Projects & Delivery when required.

Short- and Long-Term Success

In the first 6–12 months, success means:

• Establishing clear structure and ownership of PMO processes and methodologies

• Delivering consistent, high-quality reporting and portfolio visibility

• Building trust and strong collaboration with project managers and key stakeholders

Longer term, you’ll take ownership of maturing the PMO into a scalable capability that supports faster, more predictable project execution, while acting as a competence center for project management across the organization.

What You Bring

You’re an experienced project professional with a strong knowledge of project, program, and portfolio management methodologies, and governance frameworks. You have the ability to design, implement, and continuously improve processes, standards, and tools. You have a strategic and analytical mindset that makes it possible to align project execution with business objectives.

You likely:

• Have 3+ years of PMO or similar experience

• Have 5+ years of project management experience

• Preferably, have a technical background as an engineer or equivalent higher education

• Balance supportive guidance with governance and control responsibilities

• Have the experience to drive change and ensure adoption of new processes and ways of working

Who You Are

You’re not just defining processes - you ensure they are used, understood, and create value. You take ownership of execution and help teams succeed through clarity, structure, and support.

You bring:

• Strong organizational awareness and ability to manage cross-functional complexity

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills

• Continuous improvement mindset focused on efficiency, quality, and predictable delivery

• Capability to coach and develop project managers and build organizational competence

• True leadership: you take ownership of the PMO function and act with integrity

Why Join Us?

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science, and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

Genmab is seeking an experienced Senior Clinical Drug Supply Manager to join our Global Clinical Drug Supply in Copenhagen. The role requires candidates to be within commuting distance of our office locations to work according to our hybrid work arrangement. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage trials.

As a Senior Manager, Global Clinical Drug Supply, you will play a pivot role supporting the development and execution of clinical drug demand forecasts and supply plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery of clinical development products across Genmab’s pipeline. Your responsibilities will include managing the demand planning and supply planning of clinical supplies. This role will partner closely with cross-functional clinical development and CMC teams to maintain accurate forecasts, support supply strategy execution, and contribute to the operational success of clinical programs. The Senior Manager will apply strong analytical, communication, and planning skills to ensure reliable clinical supply while contributing to continuous process improvement across GCDS.

As a Senior Clinical Drug Supply Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring efficient delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage Genmab clinical trials worldwide.

The ideal candidate possesses an understanding of cGMP and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality work, demonstrating a proactive approach and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure the best outcome for patients.

This position is hybrid and requires you to be in the office 60% of the time.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning & Forecasting

• Support the development, maintenance, and updates of clinical drug demand forecasts across assigned studies and programs.

• Collaborate with, CTT, and Finance to collect inputs and ensure forecasts reflect current enrollment trends, protocol changes, and assumptions.

• Manage the demand planning discussions as part of the Clinical Project Supply Team (CPST) and support forecasting activities within the CSIOP process.

• Identify potential demand risks and escalate issues in a timely manner, recommending mitigation actions where appropriate.

• Prepare demand plan summaries, enrollment updates, and cost forecasts to support program planning and operational reviews.

Supply Strategy & Execution

• Coordinate clinical supply–related planning activities, ensuring alignment between forecasted needs, study timelines, and supply availability.

• Support the execution of clinical supply chain sourcing strategies using third-party providers, in collaboration with Clinical Operations and Supply Leads.

• Contribute to communication of GCDS Planning Strategy within Global Clinical Teams, ensuring supply planning assumptions are clearly understood.

• Track supply readiness and highlight risks or gaps that could affect clinical trial continuity.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management

• Support Supplier Relationship Management activities by tracking supplier performance metrics and helping identify improvement opportunities.

• Build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional partners (Clinical Operations, CTT, CDM, Regulatory, CMC, QA, and Finance) to enable timely and accurate supply planning.

Budget & Cost Optimization

• Support budget development activities by preparing supply planning inputs and cost forecasts aligned with program needs.

• Monitor budget performance and identify variances, working with senior team members to implement cost-effective solutions.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

• Provide planning updates and forecasting insights to support governance forums (IRC, CTT, Asset Meetings).

• Ensure consistent use of supply chain processes, tools, and systems by adhering to established standards and contributing feedback for enhancements.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on advancing forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and collaboration across GCDS.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

• Ensure demand planning and supply–related activities comply with GxP, regulatory standards, and Genmab quality expectations.

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation for demand forecasts, planning assumptions, and supply updates.

• Support identification and resolution of compliance gaps and contribute to corrective and preventive actions as needed

• Adhere to the Genmab Quality Management System

Qualifications

•    Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Supply Chain Management).

•    Minimum 8+ years of experience in clinical drug supply forecasting, supply planning, and demand planning

•    Demonstrated stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.

•    Experience working with vendors and CMOs for clinical trial supplies will be an advantage.

•    Solid knowledge of GDP and GMP. Knowledge of GCP will be an advantage.

•    Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

•    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

•    Highly organized with a structured, process-oriented mindset that supports continuous improvement.

•    Ability to prioritize effectively while maintaining a high level of quality and compliance.

•    Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work both independently and within global teams.

•    Results-driven and goal-oriented, committed to contributing to Genmab’s success.

The Team

You will join a highly competent team focused on demand planning and supply planning on clinical supplies, collaborating closely with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Execution team. Together with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Systems team and Global Clinical Drug Supply Manufacturing team, these four functions form the Global Clinical Drug Supply department. We foster a supportive, international, and fast-paced work environment centered on collaboration, excellence, and a can-do attitude to achieve results.
